task.title: Use advanced schema controls
task.shortdesc: Reach advanced schema-shell and preference controls from All Settings without treating Guided as the complete editor.

prereq.p: Open All Settings in Catalog mode.

context.p: Advanced controls remain deliberate. All Settings is the superset for schema-backed policies and preferences that are not first-class Guided controls.

step.cmd: Switch to Catalog mode and open the advanced schema or preference disclosure.

info.p: Expected result: the All Settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Review whether the control is Guided-covered, All-Settings-only, raw, deprecated, or schema-dependent.

info.p: Expected result: the All Settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Edit only the advanced control needed for the profile goal.

info.p: Expected result: the All Settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Validate and save before returning to Guided, JSON, or the Library.

info.note: Changing settings can affect the exported Firefox policy. Review source, validation, and schema support before saving.

result.p: The advanced setting is reached and changed deliberately without duplicate default editors.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the control is unsupported in the selected schema, leave it unchanged and document the schema boundary.
